sources.title: Qwen 3.6 27B VRAM & Hardware Requirements — Dense 27B GPU Guide (2026)
sources.snippet: Qwen released Qwen3.6-27B on April 22, 2026 — a dense 27B model with vision capability that beats the previous-gen flagship Qwen3.5-397B-A17B MoE on SWE-bench Verified (77.2% vs 76.2%) while needing only a fraction of the hardware. If you have a 16-24GB GPU, this is the single most important open-weight release of 2026 Q2.
